description:
Windows tray app for viewing local Codex usage limits.

A small Windows tray application that reads local Codex usage and task-state metadata. It displays weekly and rolling five-hour limits through widgets, a tray icon and a multi-display taskbar indicator. Available resets use the installed, signed-in Codex client, which may contact OpenAI for account metadata. The meter requests no password or API key and includes no analytics or telemetry.
- Updates the .NET and Windows Desktop runtimes bundled with the Windows installer and portable build to [.NET 10.0.15](https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.15/10.0.15.md), which includes Microsoft's November 2026 security fixes.
- Sets .NET SDK 10.0.404 as the minimum build SDK so self-contained builds include the patched runtime.
